description: Experiment 3, GPU runs: P with its Poisson solve on A40 GPUs (the GPU build of heat_parallel), one rank per GPU and per socket of 36 cores: 1 rank x 36 threads with one GPU, then 2 ranks x 36 threads with the two GPUs of a Vanda GPU node. The serial references are those of experiments 1 and 2. Blocking exchange only.
